title: Sturdy desk but assembly of many parts takes over 2 hours  & measurements are wrong
text:
Sturdy desk but assembly of many parts takes over 2 hours & measurements are wrong. My boyfriend purchased this table for his 27" iMac. I had recommended he purchase a collapsible sewing table instead but he decided on this and regretted it. First of all, it comes in many parts. He tried for three days to assemble this and only got the frame for the side shelves together. I decided to see if I could put this together and it took me over two hours to get the remaining pieces together.

To my boyfriend the instructions were terrible. To me who puts a lot of items together, I found them satisfactory but lacking in certain details. For instance, it never says to install the second bracket or tells the user to face the top small table piece a certain way so that it is flush with the frame. I actually had to remove the top black piece I installed because when it is screwed in one way, the larger desk piece has holes that do not line up. Once I uninstalled the top black piece and then turned it in the other direction, it fit fine. Also, it is important to ensure that the holes in all of the bars are facing as pictured in the diagram.

Once it was together, it looked great as can be seen in my finished photo. However, the measurements online say this is 40"D x 24"W x 30"H when in reality it is 23-3/4"D (front to back--meaning from where the users sits to the wall) x 39-1/2" W (side to side) x 29-1/2" H (bottom to top--meaning how tall it is). First of all they switched the diameter and width measurements on the Amazon site but secondly if we switch those numbers they are 1/2" less on the width and 1/4" less on the diameter assuming they meant to say 24"D x 40"W x 30"H.

In summary, once assembled, this unit is very sturdy and minimalistic and looks very nice. The assembly is long and some people will find that frustrating. The measurements are not as advertised. Also, one of the smaller black shelves had a mark on it from the factory. To me this is 3 stars at the current price of $84.99 plus tax. To my boyfriend, he rates this 2 stars. He was ready to send it back because he was unable to assemble it. Once it was assembled, he is happy with it but does not like that the measurements are slightly off.
